# MoTabBar

The phone tab bar: a floating 60pt pill of labelled tabs with the ink new-delegation disc beside it.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoTabBar` · 14 Phone

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoTabBar value="…" onChange={…} />
```


| prop | type | note |

| `tabs` | `MoTab[]` | Activity, Channels, Library, PRs by default. |
| `value` * | `string` |  |
| `onChange` * | `(id: string) => void` |  |
| `needs` | `number` | Count of threads waiting on you; any above zero shows the diamond. |
| `onNew` | `() => void` | Shows the new-delegation disc. |
| `placement` | `'float' \| 'static'` | Web only: static lays it out in flow (previews); float pins it 28pt above the bottom. |
